appDesc.message: Clip your tabs together like a paperclip!

sendCurrentTab.message: Send only this tab to TabClip

sendTabsExceptThis.message: Send all tabs except this tab to TabClip

sendAllTabsInCurrentWindow.message: Send all tabs in current window to TabClip

sendAllTabsInAllWindows.message: Send all tabs from all windows to TabClip

sendTabsToTheLeft.message: Send tabs on the left to TabClip

sendTabsToTheRight.message: Send tabs on the right to TabClip
